about.title: About us
about.p1: Castle Perfume is a Jordanian brand aiming to deliver a premium fragrance experience at affordable prices, with a focus on variety, quality, and customer service.
about.p2: We strive to build trust with our customers through transparency and continuous follow-up.
legal.terms.title: Terms & Conditions
legal.terms.intro: Welcome to Castle Perfume. By using our website or app, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions below. Please read them carefully to ensure the best shopping experience.
legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Terms of Use
legal.terms.s1.p: This platform is dedicated to ordering Castle perfumes and our signature blends. By continuing to browse, you commit to using the site for lawful purposes and within the laws of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.
legal.terms.s2.title: 2. Customer Account
legal.terms.s2.p: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account details (email and phone number). Using fake accounts is prohibited, and we reserve the right to suspend any account if illegal activity is suspected.
legal.terms.s3.title: 3. Orders and Pricing
legal.terms.s3.p: We strive to provide accurate details for prices and sizes. In the event of a technical error in the price, you will be contacted to correct it before shipping. The order is considered active once confirmed by our team.
legal.terms.s4.title: 4. Intellectual Property
legal.terms.s4.p: All trademarks, designs, and content on the site are the exclusive property of Castle Perfume. Reproduction or use of any part of it without prior written permission is strictly prohibited.
legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
legal.terms.s5.p: We are not responsible for any damages resulting from misuse of the product or personal allergies to certain ingredients (please always review the perfume notes).
legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Governing Law
legal.terms.s6.p: These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, and the courts of Amman shall have jurisdiction over any dispute that may arise.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: At Castle Perfume, we value your trust and are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data in compliance with international standards and major app store requirements.
legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Types of Data We Collect
legal.privacy.s1.p: We collect your name, phone number, email address, and delivery address to process your orders and secure your account. We also collect technical data such as device type and request IDs to improve app performance and resolve technical issues.
legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
legal.privacy.s2.p: We use your data (including your email) to manage your account, process orders, send shipping updates via WhatsApp, provide personalized recommendations, and verify your identity during sign-in.
legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. Data Protection and Security
legal.privacy.s3.p: We apply the highest encryption and security standards to protect your data from unauthorized access. Your data is stored on secure servers and under continuous monitoring.
legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Sharing Data with Third Parties
legal.privacy.s4.p: We never sell your data. We only share necessary information with authorized delivery companies and payment service providers (if applicable) to ensure the successful completion of your order.
legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Your Rights as an Individual
legal.privacy.s5.p: You have the full right to access your data, correct it, or request to delete your account entirely from the security page in your profile or by contacting us directly.
legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Updates and Consent
legal.privacy.s6.p: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in privacy laws. Your continued use of our services constitutes your agreement to the latest version.
legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Cart and Checkout Analytics
legal.privacy.s7.p: Cart and checkout tracking starts operationally when adding products or proceeding through checkout. Tracked events include cart modifications, step progress, field focus/completion, coupons, validation errors, and order completion. Approved recovery context includes name, normalized phone, governorate/area, cart items/value, and timestamps. We do NOT collect raw keystrokes, mouse movement/session replay, passwords, OTPs, payment credentials, or raw pre-order notes for analytics. Data access is restricted to authorized operations/support admins with bounded queries, retained indefinitely without automatic deletion, and never sold. Automated WhatsApp abandon alerts are sent exclusively to the Castle administrator and never automatically message shoppers; outreach to shoppers is always a manual staff action.
legal.return.title: Exchange & Warranty Policy
legal.return.intro: At Castle Perfumes, your satisfaction is key. Our 2-day warranty & exchange policy is clear and hassle-free so you can order with complete peace of mind.
legal.return.s1.title: 1. 2-Day Warranty Period
legal.return.s1.p: Warranty is valid for 2 days only from the date of receipt.
legal.return.s2.title: 2. Exchanges Only (No Refunds)
legal.return.s2.p: Sold items cannot be returned for a cash refund (exchange only, no cash refunds). Exchange is available within 2 working days of your request.
legal.return.s3.title: 3. Fragrance Specifications & Dupes
legal.return.s3.p: Castle perfumes are alternative dupes inspired by luxury fragrances. They are NOT original brand perfumes, NOT sealed, and DO NOT have barcodes.
legal.return.s4.title: 4. Delivery Fees & Free Exchange for Damaged/Wrong Items
legal.return.s4.p: Standard exchange delivery fees are 4 JOD for all governorates. In case of damaged or wrong items, exchange is completely free with zero delivery fee. Exchanges are processed and delivered within 2 working days.
legal.return.s5.title: 5. Speed & Commitment
legal.return.s5.p: All exchange requests are executed and delivered within 2 working days maximum.
